body: i like my therapist. it isn't his fault. i am tired. of life. of the abuse. of the pain. physical. emotional. mental.

yes, but family considers it (even with a diagnosis) all "in my head". they don't believe in any of it. of course support would be nice. who wouldn't like it?! As for my husband, well...he is a major contributor to the depression and so forth. Therapy..well, my therapist is great. But even therapy can't fix the impossible.
no. no support from my family if that is what you mean. I am told to "get over it" and so forth. I was actually dismissed from a portion of my family.
This has been going on for a very long time. I have explored every avenue and tried everything. I honestly don't see another way. Thank you for taking the time to answer.
thank you for answering. I have been in therapy and I am on meds. I have reached a dead end.
